questions.text: In an apartment complex, the monthly electricity consumption (in units) for five flats is 320, 400, 360, 340, and 380. If the residents want to know the average monthly consumption (in units) per flat by using the direct method, what value will they obtain?
Seven years ago Ramu was five times as old as his son. The present age difference between Ramu and his son is 28 years. Find the sum of their present ages.
The fourth proportional to three positive numbers is 120. If the first number is twice the second, and the third number is five times the first, then find the sum of all the three numbers.

If a candidate has scored 1280 marks in the test, how many questions did the candidate answer correctly?

For the remaining half, he revises the marked price to 80% above the cost price and then offers a discount of 30%. Find the overall profit percentage earned by the trader.
